name: Stack Exchange API
measures: Questions asked on Stack Overflow per month
about: The Stack Exchange API reports how many questions were asked in a date range. We request only that monthly total, and do not store any questions or answers.
license: API Terms of Use, with attribution
attribution: Source: Stack Exchange Network, Stack Overflow, through the Stack Exchange API.
limitations: It covers one site, and its decline can have causes unrelated to AI.
